Run several regression models to predict price. Rank columns by absolute correlation, with 1 being more accurate.

Then, one all those are done, 
Run classification models *on* the previous predictions to see if it can predict whether each regression model overpredicted or underpredicted the price. Rank columns by absolute correlation to accuracy, with 1 being more accurate.

Once all models are done, compare rankings. Measure:
Mean rank
Median rank
Mean-median difference (MMD)
Total variation (TV)
MMD-TV spread
MMD-Largest spread
MMD-Smallest spread

Then sum all of the above. A smaller number is better as it indicates a feature that is more likely to be predictive in all models.
